description: An oil-painting style scene: a large brass horn loudspeaker on a dark pole dominates the left foreground, with a second horn further back. Below it a dense crowd of men in bowler hats and dark overcoats faces a wooden platform with a railing and a microphone on a stand. Behind them a classical stone government building with columns, a pediment and a dome rises under a smoky grey sky, with small figures on a balcony. No text, frame or visible people in close detail.
